# Topic sheet — Mathematics Thuto 5

**Generated by `npm run print:topics` (scripts/print-topics.ts), not typed** — the first
human checkpoint (PRD §8.1), and it cannot drift from the data. Confirm or correct
the hours-to-lessons mapping; do not re-derive the year.

> **One departure from the printed ATP column, recorded here** (PRD §18.8 #3): the
> ATP prints PROBABILITY inside the DATA CYCLE column with 14 hours across both.
> This sheet splits it 9 (data) + 5 (probability) into two topics, because reading a
> graph and running an experiment are two different shapes.

> **One departure read off the printed page** (Appendix A finding 3): line symmetry
> is treated as Grade 4 pre-knowledge (it sits in Term 2's PREREQUISITE row on the
> page), so it is in ARRIVES_WITH and *Flat Shapes* teaches drawing one instead.
